questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct word order.
choices: Always I am tired on Monday.
I am always tired on Monday.
I always am tired on Monday.
I am tired always on Monday.

questions.question: In English, every full sentence needs at least a subject and a verb.
Write the correct pronoun to replace "my friends and I" as an object.
Which sentence is grammatically correct?
choices: If I will have time, I call you.
If I have time, I will call you.
If I had time, I will call you.
If I have time, I call you will.

questions.question: A clear paragraph usually has an introduction, development and conclusion.
Give one polite expression to disagree in English.
Which strategy best helps revise vocabulary long term?
Self-correction after writing can improve both grammar and precision.
